title: Storybound flag declaration
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/flags/<path>.json — declares a story flag or variable. The file id is the flag key.

type.description: Value type. A declared flag can only hold this type.

default.description: Value when nothing was written. Defaults to false, 0 or an empty string.

scope.description: Where the value lives. A declared flag can only be written in this scope.

sync.description: Send the value to clients (for UI and client scripts). Other flags stay on the server.

description.description: A note for modpack authors; never shown to players.
